name: Mending
summary: Repairs one break or tear up to 1 foot across in an object you touch; can't restore magic.
text: Fix a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a snapped chain link, a key broken in two, a ripped cloak or a leaking wineskin. If the damage is no larger than 1 foot in any dimension, it is mended without a trace. The spell can physically repair a magic item but can't restore its magic.
